description: This file defines the ReportingMethodController class, which manages reporting method configurations within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It extends a base Vue controller, interacts with the ReportingMethodConfigurationService, and sets up a Vue component with unselectable reporting method IDs for rendering.

classes.name: ReportingMethodController
classes.description: Controller class that manages the reporting method configurations, extending AbstractVueController, and prepares Vue components for rendering reporting method data.

methods.name: getReportingMethodService
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of ReportingMethodConfigurationService, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and Vue components before rendering, including fetching reporting method IDs in use and setting up the reporting method list component.
